[SWS_DM_00369] Max number of Response Pending Messages
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04016, RS_Diag_04249, RS_Diag_04277
⌈
If the number of negative responses for a requested diagnostic request reaches the
value defined in the configuration parameter
maxNumberOfRequestCorrectlyRe-
ceivedResponsePending
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
module shall
cancel the processing of the active diagnostic internal or external request process-
ing, according to [SWS_DM_00277], [SWS_DM_00278] and send a negative response
with NRC 0x10 (
generalReject
).
⌋
